PTPA NOW HIRING: Medical Coding Scholar (January 2027) — Employee Referral - Allied Health Courses
Feeling tired or burned out from hospital work?

If you’re looking to transition into a non-bedside & non voice healthcare role, this opportunity may be for you. Sharing this opportunity for those interested in medical coding.

This is for referral purposes only — I am not part of HR or recruitment.

📌 Program Details:

Company Name: Tenet / Conifer Health Solutions

✔ Paid training + CPC-A certification

✔ Competitive salary + HMO

✔ Full-time, onsite during training (BGC, Taguig + Bridgetowne, QC)

✔ Open to fresh graduates from health-allied courses except Biology and Psychology (no prior coding experience required) 

 ✔ With 2-year training bond

📅 Target start date: January 11 batch

📋 How to Apply (Referral Process)

Fill out the Google Form: https://forms.gle/M5kZbpxCgbY4QVo

Selection Process: Short assessment, initial interview, and final interview

Please read carefully before applying. Thank you and good luck!

items.text:
Hello po! I need your advice. I have over 4 years of experience in BPO, specifically in US healthcare. I’m already familiar with claims, benefits, eligibility, authorizations, and other healthcare-related processes.

I’m planning to transition into a Medical VA role, pero hindi pa ako familiar sa mga tools and systems commonly used by Medical VAs.

Do you think I need to attend a paid training course? The last one I inquired about was around ₱4,000+, and they said it already includes an internship.

For those who transitioned from US healthcare BPO to Medical VA, worth it ba mag-invest sa paid training, especially if I already have healthcare experience? Or are there free resources/courses that you would recommend?

Would really appreciate your advice. Thank you! 💗

topComments.text: No need to attend trainings, di naman yan nake-credit. Apply ka sa mga medical VA agency such as MMM and hellorache. Do your research super dami nila. They will train you naman sa tools na need mo matutunan and sa gamit ni client. I believe super qualified ka dahil mostly 1 - 2 years expi lang naman required nila.

You can try enrolling in the Virtual Assistant Academy Pro Training Courses. After the training, they provide companies where you can apply. I personally got 2 clients now. They also have mock interviews in their student dashboard, so you can really practice. Many of us have already been successfully deployed. They are 100% legit, tried and tested! 😃

items.text: Shoutout po kay GLEN A. na VA na sobrang suplado kausap. Alam nman nmen na malaki sahod mo kesa samin dukhang bpo agent ng healthcare pero sana nmn sir glen tao ka mkipag usap. Sa susunod po ayusin mo ung promt na pinipindot mo sa IVR para di ka ma route sa ibang department tapos pag trinansfer ka ikaw pa galit? Nag mumura ka pa sa line ai wow!

items.text: Hi guys, I just wanted to ask. Ano thoughts nyo sa SnapScale? I do have 2yrs and 5 months Dental Insurance Verification and 7 months Dental Billing Specialist (WFH currently employed) medjo na bagot ako sa Wfh setup. Ask lng sana ako if magkano sahoran sa SnapScale Davao site. Thank you sa mga mag sasagot. 🫶🏻

Hi everyone. Gusto ko lang talaga mag-rant at maglabas ng nararamdaman. 🥺

**5 months na akong naghahanap ng work, pero hanggang ngayon wala pa rin.** Ang dami ko nang rejections, ghosting, assessments, interviews, at applications na hindi na nasundan. Pero kahit nakakapagod, **hindi pa rin ako sumusuko.**

Galing ako sa BPO, and recently nailipat ako ng LOB kaya under training pa ako noon. Then, may blessing na dumating sa buhay namin — **nabuntis ako.** ❤️

Pero behind that blessing came a difficult situation. Dahil maselan ang pregnancy ko, kinailangan kong mag-bed rest at hindi makapasok for a month. I provided my medical certificate, pero unfortunately, **na-terminate pa rin ako.**

Since then, halos lahat na yata ng platforms sinubukan ko — job sites, social media, direct applications, agencies, LinkedIn, and even reaching out directly to potential clients.

Pero hanggang ngayon, naghahanap pa rin ako. 😔

As a pregnant mom with a 1-year-old daughter, **sobrang stressful at nakaka-pressure** hindi magkaroon ng stable income. May mga bills, may needs ang anak, at syempre gusto ko ring makatulong sa family namin.

May mga araw na nakaka-frustrate. May mga araw na napapaisip ako kung may darating pa bang opportunity para sa akin. Pero every time na may rejection, I remind myself na **hindi ibig sabihin na hindi ako capable. Baka hindi lang talaga para sa akin yung opportunity na iyon.**

Nakaka-inspire talaga makita yung mga nagpo-post ng **“client dust”** nila. ✨

Yung iba, ilang months din naghanap bago nakakuha ng client.

Sana ako rin. 🙏🏻

Hindi ko alam kung kailan darating yung breakthrough ko, pero **patuloy pa rin akong mag-aapply, matututo, at susubok.**

If anyone knows a small business, dental clinic, healthcare practice, or business owner who needs a **Virtual Assistant / Customer Support / Healthcare VA / Admin Assistant**, I would truly appreciate a referral or lead.

I may not have direct VA client experience yet, but I have **4 years of customer service experience**, including healthcare support, appointment scheduling, insurance and benefits inquiries, customer support, administrative tasks, and working with U.S. customers.

**Still applying. Still hoping. Still believing. 🤍**

Baka this post will reach the right person. ✨

🚨 YOUR MEDICAL CODING CAREER STARTS HERE! 🎓💙
TENET HEALTH | MEDICAL CODING ACADEMY – WAVE 7

Ready to turn your Medical Allied background into an exciting career in Medical Coding? 👀✨

We’re opening a NEW BATCH of Medical Coding Academy (MCA) trainees starting January 11, 2027!

Whether you’re a Nursing, MedTech, Pharmacy, PT, RT, RadTech, or other eligible Medical Allied graduate, this could be your next career move! 🩺💻

🎓 FREE & PAID TRAINING OPTIONS

Get the training and skills you need to build your path toward becoming a certified medical coder.

📍 AVAILABLE SITES

• BGC, Taguig

• Bridgetowne, Quezon City

🏢 Setup: Pure Onsite

✅ WHO CAN APPLY?

• Medical Allied graduates

• Nursing

• Medical Technology

• Pharmacy

• Physical Therapy

• Respiratory Therapy

• Radiologic Technology

• Other eligible allied health courses

• Underboard candidates are welcome!

💙 WHY JOIN TENET HEALTH?

✨ Competitive Salary Package

✨ HMO with 2 FREE Dependents

✨ Fixed Weekends Off

✨ Performance Incentives + Annual Increase

✨ Shuttle Service

✨ Free Coffee ☕

✨ Rice & Clothing Allowance

✨ Night Differential + Shift Allowance

✨ Christmas Bonus + Holiday Basket 🎁

🚀 READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP?

Slots for MCA Wave 7 are LIMITED, so don’t wait until they’re gone!

✨ Your healthcare knowledge + medical coding skills = a whole new career opportunity.

Start your journey with Tenet Health this January 2027! 💙🎓

📋 APPLY HERE: https://forms.gle/x1k7qsd37vdd4rgV9
